nsid.description: Namespace ID of the service or application (e.g., 'uk.skyblur.post').

tags.description: This field contains tags. If registered by the owner, it may include 'Verified'.

schema.description: The schema URL pattern associated with this NSID (e.g., 'https://skyblur.uk/post/{did}/{rkey}').

comments.description: Comments with titles, content, and moderation in multiple languages.

ogpImage.description: The Open Graph Protocol (OGP) image URL for the bookmark.

ogpTitle.description: The Open Graph Protocol (OGP) title for the bookmark.

verified.description: If this comment registed by owner, this field should be true.

moderations.description: Moderation result for OGP title and description

ogpDescription.description: The Open Graph Protocol (OGP) description for the bookmark.

output.description: Returns the Bookmark data for the given NSID.

main.description: Get Bookmark by NSID, including schema, OGP, tags, moderation, and comments.
